messages.subject: The Drum and Fortune take the Spotlight
messages.body:
Our keynote stages have new names and two major media brands at the helm. The Drum will host the Spotlight Stage, while Fortune will host the Signals Stage.
What you can expect from each:
Spotlight stage
Where marketing is going
The Main Stage is now called the Spotlight Stage, hosted by The Drum. 
CMOs, platform leaders, and brand builders from Adobe, LinkedIn, OpenAI, and more discuss how discovery is shifting and what makes someone choose your brand.
Open to all pass holders

Signals stage
What to act on now
The Enterprise Stage is now called the Signals Stage, hosted by Fortune. 
Analysts and operators from Forrester, Wix, Chili Piper, and more break down AI visibility, measurement, agents, and the org changes that follow.
Only All Access & VIP pass holders
Meet your keynote stage hosts
Gordon Young
Co-Founder and Editor-in-Chief, The Drum
Kamal Ahmed
Executive Editorial Director, Fortune
Gordon and Kamal join 80+ speakers bringing the latest thinking on search, AI, content, brand, and visibility to London this October.
Join the leaders shaping what comes next. Leave knowing what to act on now.
Book your VIP pass today to experience both sides of the conversation. Save 20% on tickets before Sept 24. <https://engage.semrush.com/dc/11kQTkGAes5Nsh5GkZMletJvO1w0Iv8UfUBHmraT-cLPhg1oXxnyB6fq-DeYMzq3mxksvHEXYMUn_JlgMebHO6-_RvjpoGGbB6ZEvmdb9Iu1agVphNOI3kTprZeBhmMyDgOfXbtAKcUE0VNU9M4DCjI7GtIryWL1ai2DrFBRpNFQ6hKbpyk-yo0jRPfSnC_x/NTE5LUlJWS04NjkAAAGkKjT5mXQmnHCRnjpZS0FTWREJ6KgHBZzmn
